page.overview:
Who is Galli?

If is the first has visited, will welcome him and introduce him to the . If says he does not, explains that he can board and summon them to any . He also tells that he can tame a wild and register it to make it his companion. While each person is limited to five , they can be swapped in and out.

When spoken to at the front of the , will welcome and ask if he wants to register or take out a . When takes a out, thanks him for choosing their .

If tries to register a without one present, will call him a comedian, saying to "quit horsing around" and to find a . When approaches the with a wild , asks if he wants to register it or rest for a while. He explains that charges a registration fee of 20 . Once the has been registered, asks if wants to board it or take it with him.

When attempting to register a or , will scold and say they only register . insists that are monsters, and he will not board it in fear of it eating the other . If tries to register the , refuses, believing they will all by cursed if he does so.
